highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback.
highlights_body: The release advances to Skia m152, adds Silk.NET Vulkan helpers, and fixes native resource lifetimes. Nano Server can render explicitly loaded fonts, while shaping and data-copy paths allocate or copy less.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer and Vulkan allocator while retaining the allocator fallback needed by SkiaSharp callers.

Adds Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn contexts, recorders, recordings, texture wrappers, and an image cache. Graphite follows an explicit record/snap/insert/submit model; existing Ganesh APIs remain unchanged.

SKImage and SKSurface.RequestReadPixels provide callback-scoped results with copy-out helpers. Copy results before the callback returns; Ganesh completion requires submission and CheckAsyncWorkCompletion.
The new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package supplies typed backend-context and extension helpers. GRVkExtensions gains a public constructor; the existing SharpVk package remains available.

bullets.lead: Source owners stay alive for dependent views
bullets.detail: Region iterators retain their source region, and pixmap subsets and With* results retain the ultimate pixel owner, preventing premature finalization.

bullets.lead: Native cleanup and failed readbacks corrected
bullets.detail: Releases the SkCachedData mutex guard before deletion and prevents Ganesh readbacks from returning stale data after failed flushes. Additional native font-rendering and Ganesh stability fixes are included.

bullets.lead: Owned buffers and streams released promptly
bullets.detail: Uniform Reset disposes its previous SKData; non-memory-backed ToHarfBuzzBlob streams are disposed by the blob release callback. Failed raster-image creation frees its allocated pixel buffer.
SKData.SaveTo writes native spans directly on span-capable targets, while older targets retain buffering. This removes an intermediate copy of each output chunk.
Font.Shape avoids copying an existing Feature array, and SKFourByteTag and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag formatting avoid char boxing.

bullets.lead: Lower object and text setup overhead
bullets.detail: Caches wrapper-registration reflection checks, pre-sizes uniform name lookups, and removes an intermediate string when encoding null-terminated text.

bullets.lead: Nano Server supports explicitly loaded fonts
bullets.detail: The FreeType-backed native variant renders fonts loaded from files, streams, or data. Its empty default font manager still provides no system fonts.
Produces separate Apple native symbol packages with complete dSYMs while keeping customer packages symbol-free. Android libraries emit GNU build IDs that match their split-debug files.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Enabled FreeType-backed font loading on Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Reduced Windows native build overhead by initializing the MSVC environment once per build
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn with backend and visual coverage

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced Graphite, asynchronous pixel readback, Silk.NET Vulkan helpers, Nano Server font loading, and source-lifetime fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: The release candidate reduced shaping allocations, fixed uniform-buffer and blob-stream cleanup, restored Silk.NET package production, and added native debugging assets.

harfbuzz_summary: Font.Shape avoids copying caller-owned Feature arrays, and Tag.ToString avoids char boxing. Apple native symbol packages and Android build IDs improve native diagnostics; bundled HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: Preview 1 introduced Graphite, asynchronous pixel readback, Silk.NET Vulkan helpers, Nano Server font loading, and source-lifetime fixes.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: The release candidate reduced shaping allocations, fixed uniform-buffer and blob-stream cleanup, restored Silk.NET package production, and added native debugging assets.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 finalizes the release with a cached-data lifetime correction.
v4.152.0.body: The native mutex guard is released before its owning cached-data object is deleted.
